response.query: Which validated self-efficacy and intention scales are best validated for HPV vaccination and prevention behaviors among rural emerging adults?
response.answer: The validated scales for self-efficacy and intention regarding HPV vaccination among rural emerging adults are the Carolina HPV Immunization Attitudes scale and the Theory of Planned Behavior scale. These tools are widely recognized for their reliability in assessing intentions and efficacy related to HPV vaccination.

results.title: 4Corners4Health Social Media Cancer Prevention Campaign for ...
results.content: The goal of this trial is to modify cancer risk factors among emerging adults aged 18 to 26 years living in rural counties in the Four Corners states of Arizona, Colorado, New Mexico, and Utah using a unique, theory-based social media campaign designed with community advisers that delivers relevant, credible, and timely content on reducing multiple cancer risks to emerging adults. We will test a social media campaign to reduce cancer risk factors among emerging adults in rural counties in the Four Corners states using a randomized stepped-wedge trial design. The planned trial has several methodological strengths, including the unique multi-institutional team of investigators with expertise in each of the health behaviors of interest as well as cancer prevention and control; a diverse, rural population; an understudied age group; extensive community engagement; a multirisk factor approach; the use of social media; a rigorous study design; and high dissemination potential.
